concerns: Only 9 of the 15 tagged past MCQs were usable as explained items, not 12: w25_11_q6, w22_11_q5 and w19_11_q4 are exact duplicates of papers already used (the validator flags duplicate questions), and two more were dropped on accuracy grounds (below). The rest of the bank is appended as extras.

Dropped 9701_w23_11_q27: the extracted stem is mangled ('HCCCH₂CH₂CHC(CH₃)₂') and the official key D (18 σ, 4 π) does not match any reading I could verify — the obvious structure HC≡C-CH2-CH2-CH=C(CH3)2 gives 19 σ and 3 π (option A). Needs the original paper/image checked before use.

Dropped 9701_s23_12_q6 (Cl–N=O): option D is glyph-corrupted ('one S and two P bonds') and option C ('the nitrogen atom is sp² hybridised') reads as chemically correct, which conflicts with the official key D. Needs the original options checked.

Options for the image-based past items with missing/garbled option text (w22_13_q5, w19_13_q4, w19_13_q37, w19_12_q32, s19_12_q4) are left exactly as the bank has them and rely on the attached figure; I inferred the statement-combination keys for q37 and q32 from the chemistry (both consistent with the official keys).

No orbital-overlap figure: diagrams.py cannot draw σ/π overlap or dot-and-cross structures, so σ/π formation, NH4+ and Al2Cl6 are described in words in the note. The one rendered figure (bond length vs bond energy) was checked by reading its SVG text, not visually — qlmanage was not permitted in this sandbox.

Bond data used: C-C 350/154 pm, C=C 610/134 pm, C#C 840/120 pm, N#N 994, O=O 496, Cl-Cl 244, Br-Br 193, I-I 151, N-H 391, C-H 410 kJ mol^-1 (Cambridge data booklet values); worth a spot-check against the booklet edition in use.
SO2 is taught with two S=O double bonds (10 outer electrons on S, expanded octet) as the syllabus statement requires; some textbooks draw a dative/charge-separated structure instead.
